doc.title: Frank Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 7, 1998

title: Life on the road by bus
summary: He enjoyed the road and bus travel until years later.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Wow. Well you were a young man, did you enjoy being on the road with that band, traveling?
Definitely. Up until about the time I left, I really enjoyed being on the road.
Mostly bus at the time. There was some air travel, but mostly the bus. And I didn’t fall out of love with the bus until years later.
